description: v4 only. Quote swapping one Aave v4 position for another, atomically and without leaving the protocol: kind=supply swaps collateral for a different collateral asset, kind=borrow swaps one debt for another. Both sides are on the same spoke. Get 'sellPosition' from get_position_items, whose 'quotableAs' says whether that item can be sold this way (supplySwapFrom or borrowSwapFrom), and 'buyReserve' from get_markets, whose 'quotableAs' says whether that reserve can receive it (supplySwapTo or borrowSwapTo). The quoteId feeds prepare_order. Nothing is committed until the user signs, so state the plan rather than asking permission to quote it.

amount.description: Amount in main units of the sold position, e.g. '100.5'.

buyReserve.description: reserveId to move into (from get_markets), on the same spoke as the position sold.

enableCollateral.description: kind=supply only: enable the bought reserve as collateral (default true).

kind.description: supply = collateral swap, borrow = debt swap.

sellPosition.description: positionItemId to sell (from get_position_items): a supply item for kind=supply, a borrow item for kind=borrow.

slippagePct.description: Optional max slippage as a percent string, e.g. '0.5'. Omit to accept the backend suggestion.

version.description: Optional, and only 'v4': this tool exists on v4 only.

name: get_position_swap_quote
title: Quote a position swap (v4)
